summary: 13 of 26 sub-steps present. The plan carries the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the label telescoping, orthonormal-basis and loss-ratio facts (L3-L5), the rank-saving inequality and exponent argument (R1, R4), the matrix-shear elimination, triangular cost and Π realisation (M1, M3, M4) and the row-sum-one truncation (S5). It lacks the residual table and side-edge complement (L1, L2), the whole phase-interface derivation (P1-P4), the two explicit deficit values (R2, R3), the prime choice (M2), and the guard-width derivation (S1-S4), where S3.5 only asserts the o(p) result.
